title: WebHaptics brings native-feeling vibration directly to the mobile web Supports React, Vue and Svelte
description:
Building mobile web apps or PWAs and missing that satisfying native tap feedback? WebHaptics brings native-feeling vibration directly to the mobile web. Supports React, Vue, and Svelte out of the box — import the hook, attach it to your UI elements, and your web app suddenly feels tactile and alive. Includes a desktop debug mode that plays audio feedback while you're testing on your computer, plus a built-in toggle so users can switch haptics on or off. 

https://github.com/lochie/web-haptics
